onboarding.whyDescription: Stop losing track of inventory, wasting time searching for items, and dealing with stockouts. StoreTool gives you complete visibility and control over your entire inventory operation.
onboarding.warehouseDesc: Create and organize multiple warehouses with custom storage units and locations.
onboarding.smartSearchDesc: Quickly locate any item with powerful search and filtering capabilities.
onboarding.barcodeScanningDesc: Scan barcodes to instantly add, find, or update inventory items.
onboarding.restockAlertsDesc: Get notified when items are running low and need restocking.
onboarding.teamCollaborationDesc: Work together with your team using shared workgroups and role-based access.
onboarding.analyticsDesc: Track inventory movements and generate detailed reports for better insights.
onboarding.demoStep1Desc: Organize your inventory across multiple warehouses with custom storage units.
onboarding.demoStep2Desc: Use barcode scanning to quickly add items to your inventory.
onboarding.demoStep3Desc: Monitor stock levels, get restock alerts, and export reports.
onboarding.demoTip1: You can create unlimited warehouses and customize them for any type of storage.
onboarding.demoTip2: Barcode scanning works with any standard barcode or QR code.
onboarding.demoTip3: Set custom restock thresholds for each item to never run out of stock.

legalprivacy.intro_body: Kulo Digital Oy is committed to protecting the privacy of StoreTool users. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your information when you use the StoreTool mobile application.
legalprivacy.section2_a_point1_body: We collect your email address strictly for the purpose of identifying your account and enabling account restoration. We do not use your email address for marketing purposes.
legalprivacy.section2_a_point2_body: Data you input into the App (e.g., inventory items, storage details) is stored securely in our backend database.
legalprivacy.section2_b_point1_body: We may collect basic device identifiers (e.g., operating system version) to ensure App compatibility and assist with support.
legalprivacy.section2_b_point2_body: We process data regarding your subscription status (e.g., "Active", "Expired") via our payment providers. We do not store your full credit card or banking details.
legalprivacy.section2_b_point3_body: The App requires camera access to scan barcodes/QR codes. Camera data is processed locally on your device for scanning purposes and is not transmitted to our servers for storage.
legalprivacy.section3_title: 3. Purpose and Legal Basis for Processing
legalprivacy.section3_intro: We process personal data for the following purposes:
legalprivacy.section3_point1_body: To provide inventory management features, sync data across devices, and restore your account.
legalprivacy.section3_point2_body: To manage your subscription access via Apple/Google stores.
legalprivacy.section3_point3_body: To comply with accounting laws regarding purchase records.
legalprivacy.section4_intro: We do not sell your data. We share data only with trusted infrastructure providers necessary to operate the App:
legalprivacy.section4_point1_body: Provides the secure backend database infrastructure.
legalprivacy.section4_point2_body: Processes subscription payments and validates purchase receipts.
legalprivacy.section4_point3_body: If data is processed outside the EU/EEA (e.g., by US-based infrastructure providers), we ensure protection via Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs).
legalprivacy.section5_point1_body: You may delete your data at any time using the App's "Secure Wipe" functionality. This action immediately removes your data from the database.
legalprivacy.section5_point2_body: If you do not wipe your data, we retain your account information for as long as you have an active account to allow you to restore access.
legalprivacy.section5_point3_body: Deleted data may remain in secure, encrypted backups for a short period (typically up to 30 days) before being permanently overwritten.
legalprivacy.section6_intro: Under the GDPR, you have the right to:
legalprivacy.section6_list_item1_body: Request a copy of the data we hold about you.
legalprivacy.section6_list_item3_body: Request deletion of your data (identifiable via your email).
legalprivacy.section6_list_item4_body: Object to processing based on legitimate interests.
legalprivacy.section6_list_item5_body: Receive your data in a machine-readable format.
legalprivacy.section6_contact_text: To exercise these rights, contact us at: privacy@kulodigital.fi.
legalprivacy.section6_ombudsman_text: You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the Data Protection Ombudsman (tietosuoja.fi).
legalprivacy.section7_body: We employ industry-standard security measures, including HTTPS encryption for data in transit and secure database storage via Supabase, to protect your personal information from unauthorized access.
legalprivacy.section8_body: We reserve the right to modify this Privacy Policy. Significant changes will be notified via an App update or a notice within the App.
